thread:
oliver: hey team, first day tomorrow. quick question: i need to connect to an external patient monitor for a demo. vendor says their driver needs a kernel extension. is there a safe path?
tess-it: welcome Oliver! short answer: kernel extensions on company Macs require a security exception. long answer: we prefer a sandboxed loaner or a VM that hits the device over the network. what's the vendor/model?
oliver: model is MedLink-3000, vendor docs specifically reference a kext for serial->usb comms. i can try an alternative bridge but the vendor insists.
sam: tagging security  we don't allow unsigned kernel changes. we can approve an exception if security + IT vet the binary, we get a vendor-signed blob, and there's a rollback plan. would you be ok with using a loaner isolated on a dedicated VLAN?
oliver: yes loaner would be fine. also i have a temporary restriction on using phone-based auth for medical reasons. can i get a hardware key?
procurement: we keep loaner YubiKeys for onboarding. reply with shipping address and "expedite" if you need it same-day. also we can provision a short-term hardware token for VPN only.
security-bot: phishsim notice: new hires are included in phishing simulations after 5 business days by default. Accommodation exemptions must be recorded in HR and flagged to security to exclude the account. Processing time ~48 business hours.
hr: @oliver if you need an MFA accommodation, file the HR accommodation form: https://redwood.example/hr/accommodations and cc security. include any supporting doc if you're comfortable. We can pause email-based phishsim while we review.
oliver: filing now. if the loaner machine is VLANed, do i need a separate user account?
tess-it: no separate username required; we'll add a device tag and apply network ACLs. you will sign a temporary device use form. we can image it with less-privileged admin to allow only the vendor software.
sam: one more on training: InfoSec training is assigned on day 2, but if accommodation affects your ability to complete interactive phishing modules, we can shift deadlines. just mention it in the form.
oliver: great, thanks. last tiny ask: who orders a USB-C to DB9 serial adapter? vendor recommends it.
procurement: we keep a small stock. i'll drop the SKU here: SKU-RT-USBCSERIAL and can ship with the YubiKey. DM address please.
oliver: sending address via DM now. thanks everyone 44d
security-bot: reminder: do not disable SIP or other system protections on company-managed machines. Exceptions must go through security-exceptions@redwood.example and include a mitigation plan.
procurement: noted about co-shipping. will mark both as "new hire - medical demo".
oliver: filing the HR form and opening the security exception ticket per sam's note. appreciate the quick responses!
